title: Remove Starting Wealth false SRD authority (ADR 0020 B4) and reconcile the SRD-only creation path
description:
Remove the Starting Wealth false-SRD-authority defect and reconcile the dependent
character-creation path in the same change. This closes ADR 0020 blocker B4 /
transition-design work item W4 ONLY. It does NOT close parent eshyra-o9bd.19.2.1.

ROOT CAUSE
The compiler authors a value and attaches SRD provenance to it. Coverage gates are
source->output only, so they cannot see it. table:starting-wealth-by-class is
produced from a hard-coded literal, yet carries source "SRD 5.1 p. 38",
provenance.locator "p. 38", and the full CC-BY-4.0 SRD attribution block. The
string "Starting Wealth" does not occur anywhere in the extracted 403-page SRD 5.1
text; p. 38 is Ranger (Hunter) subclass features.

EXACT SCOPE MEMBERSHIP (verified against main @042ce11 on 2026-07-31)

Importer + generated pack:
1. emit.ts:126-149 - delete startingWealthTable() and its false doc-comment
   "Source-backed p. 38 Starting Wealth by Class table."
2. emit.ts:1626-1628 - delete the conditional append
   `input.classes?.length === 12 ? [...(input.tables ?? []), startingWealthTable()]`;
   sourceTables becomes `input.tables ?? []`.
3. emit.ts:170 - in the manifest description template, replace the stale
   `loreweaver-0m9.5` with `eshyra-0m9.5` (AGENTS.md: historical loreweaver-*
   references map by swapping only the prefix). This is item 4 of the parent and
   the ONLY parent item beyond Starting Wealth in scope here. Fix it at the
   importer source, not only in the generated file, or regeneration reintroduces it.
4. Regenerate: `npm run import:dnd5e-srd`, then `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack`.
   Expected regenerated outputs: records.json, manifest.json, source-inventory.json,
   source-coverage.json, source-region-ledger.json, and the importer's
   .generated/manifest.json.
5. DO NOT TOUCH docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/freeze-manifest.json. Do not update
   its hashes, and do not add a thaw note. The freeze guard is dormant for the whole
   eshyra-o9bd re-audit epic: the srd-freeze-guard workflow was removed,
   verify:dnd5e-srd-freeze is in neither CI nor verify:worktree,
   THAW_NOTE_CHECK_ENABLED = false (eshyra-nsd1), and the hash check already fails on
   main by design. The pinned hashes are the PRE-THAW BASELINE that re-freeze diffs
   against; re-pinning them mid-epic destroys that baseline and launders every
   intervening pack change into the 'audited' snapshot. Re-pinning belongs to
   eshyra-o9bd.14 then eshyra-2zyy, and to nothing else. IGNORE the contrary
   instructions in thaw-notes/TEMPLATE.md and the pre-2026-07 thaw notes: they predate
   the thaw. See bd memory srd-freeze-manifest-hashes-frozen-until-o9bd-closes.

Audit:
6. srdAudit.ts:294 - remove 'table:starting-wealth-by-class' from
   SRD_5_1_STANDALONE_TABLES. Leave 'table:proficiency-bonus-by-challenge-rating'.
   The committed-pack test that asserts every allow-list entry is still an emitted
   table is what keeps these two sides consistent - do not weaken it.

Runtime / creation path:
7. rulesPackResolver.ts:1283-1289 resolveStartingWealth - when NO active pack
   provides the table, return a truthful `not_found` whose message says no active
   rules pack provides a starting-wealth table. Do NOT keep returning `malformed`:
   its message ("Generated table record ... is missing fields required for
   character creation") becomes an actively false claim once the record is
   intentionally absent, which is the exact defect class this bead exists to close.
   KEEP `malformed` for a table that is present but broken, so a future supplement
   still fails closed.
8. Add an availability query to RulesPackCharacterResolver
   (rulesPackResolver.ts:325-345) - e.g. `startingWealthAvailable(): boolean` -
   true iff an active pack in the stack provides the table. JUDGMENT CALL, flag it
   in your completion report: this interface is exported from the ROOT public
   surface (index.ts:232), so adding a required method is a breaking change for
   external implementers. Accepted because the CLI is the only real consumer today
   and the alternative - callers string-matching an error message - is worse.
   Wire createRulesPackCharacterResolver (:377) accordingly.
9. srdStartingWealth.ts - resolveStartingWealth throws result.message, so the
   truthful unavailable message surfaces. Make unavailable distinguishable from
   malformed for callers. Keep the exported signatures of resolveStartingWealth,
   rollStartingWealth, validateStartingWealthResult (index.ts:242-244).
10. finalizeCharacter.ts:281-347 validateFinalStartingAcquisition - reject
    'starting-wealth' mode with a truthful error when no active pack provides the
    table.
11. characterDraft.ts:586 - reject the mode at draft validation if a resolver is in
    scope there; if it is not, the gate lives in finalizeCharacter plus the
    engine's setStartingEquipmentMode. Verify which before choosing.
12. characterWizard.ts:719-775 - do not offer the wealth option when unavailable;
    adapt the prompt and help text; entering 2/wealth reports it unavailable rather
    than setting an unusable mode.

13. packages/core/test/startingWealth.test.ts CONTAINS A SECOND FULL COPY OF THE PHB
    TABLE. Lines 21-33 are an `expected` map of all twelve classes to
    [formula, multiplierGp] (barbarian 2d4x10 ... wizard 4d4x10), and line 11 asserts
    the fighter row. Removing the record from the pack while leaving this file would
    leave the unsupported PHB content sitting in the repo, which the required
    invariant forbids. This file must not survive with those numbers in it: delete it,
    or rewrite it to cover only unavailability under SRD-only plus the synthetic
    supplement path with invented values. Do not "fix" it by keeping the values.
    (Missed by an earlier case-sensitive survey - `startingWealth` does not match
    `resolveStartingWealth`. If you search for more instances, search case-insensitively.)
14. Adding a method to RulesPackCharacterResolver (item 8) breaks every in-repo
    implementer and test double. Known: packages/core/test/rulesPackCharacterResolver.test.ts,
    and the consumers listed by
    `grep -rl RulesPackCharacterResolver packages/*/src packages/*/test`. Reconcile all
    of them; do not loosen the interface to avoid the work.

MUST PRESERVE (genuinely SRD)
Class starting-EQUIPMENT choices (collectEquipment package path, class.equipment.*
choices) and background equipment grants including their currencyGp wallet
(finalizeCharacter.ts packages branch). These are real SRD content and must keep working.

REQUIRED INVARIANT
No output carries SRD provenance or the CC-BY-4.0 SRD attribution block for content
that is not in SRD 5.1. Starting wealth is permitted ONLY when a separately
identified, appropriately licensed pack provides it.

REJECTED APPROACHES
- Re-homing the existing table by relabeling it supplemental. The defect is its
  source and redistribution rights, not its label.
- Reproducing the PHB table under any new name, in any file, including tests and
  fixtures. Synthetic test data must use obviously-invented values, never the PHB
  numbers.
- Deleting only the generated record while leaving the importer able to re-emit it.

REGRESSION EVIDENCE (permanent; each must fail on the old behavior)
a. Pack absence: table:starting-wealth-by-class is absent from the committed SRD
   pack. Update the two existing assertions at srdGeneratedPack.test.ts:4803 and
   :4834 (EXPECTED_SRD_5_1_TABLE_NAMES + 'Starting Wealth by Class') to absence.
b. SRD-only unavailability: the bundled SRD resolver reports starting wealth
   unavailable, and finalizeCharacter rejects 'starting-wealth' mode with the
   truthful error.
c. Positive control: SRD-only character creation still completes through the
   packages path with class starting-equipment choices and background currency.
d. Supplement path still works: a SYNTHETIC add-on pack supplying a starting-wealth
   table (invented values, not PHB numbers) makes the mode available and finalize
   succeeds. This proves the mechanism was disabled by data, not deleted.
e. P12 standing guard (ADR 0020 probe P12): no record in the committed SRD pack
   claims SRD provenance or CC attribution for starting wealth. Keep this narrow -
   it asserts the absence of THIS record and THIS claim. Do NOT write a corpus-wide
   negative; the transition design's section 5.9 bar explicitly does not require one
   and the corpus cannot support it.
f. Existing tests to reconcile - the COMPLETE list, from a case-insensitive survey at
   042ce11: packages/core/test/startingWealth.test.ts (see item 13),
   packages/core/test/finalizeCharacter.test.ts:264-347,
   packages/cli/test/characterWizard.test.ts:155-167, and
   packages/core/test/srdGeneratedPack.test.ts:4803,4834. All currently exercise or
   assert the wealth path against the bundled SRD pack. Convert them to unavailability
   assertions and re-express working-path coverage against the synthetic supplement
   pack from (d).

SUPERSEDED FALSE CLAIM (record it, do NOT write a thaw note)
The thaw note docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/thaw-notes/2026-07-12-eshyra-2n1t-10-starting-wealth-table.md
claims this table is "source-backed ... from the SRD p. 38 Starting Wealth by Class
table". That claim is FALSE and is how this defect entered. Do NOT edit that
historical note and do NOT add a new thaw note (see item 5 - per-change thaw notes are
suspended for this epic). Instead, state the correction in your commit message body
and in your completion report, so it is durable in git history and reaches the
re-freeze bead.

EXPLICITLY OUT OF SCOPE
- Parent item 2 (animal-friendship text-layer-omission sourceCorrection),
  item 3 (Bag of Beans successful-save outcome, co-owned with eshyra-o9bd.19.4.5),
  item 5 (composed sourceText / synthesized choice labels / synthesized table headers).
- Do NOT invent a field-level provenance representation. Items 2 and 5 remain
  blocked on eshyra-o9bd.19.1.3, which is chartered to build it. There is no
  field-level derivation marker in types.ts or kindSchemas.ts today and this bead
  must not add one.
- Do NOT author supplemental starting-wealth content.
- Do NOT claim the parent's five-item semantic class is complete anywhere - not in
  code comments, the thaw note, test names, or your completion report.

COMPLETION PROOF
`npm run verify:worktree` from this worktree root BEFORE committing (it rewrites
files), plus `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack` proving importer output matches the
committed pack exactly. Do NOT run or act on `npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-freeze`: it
fails on main by design during this epic (see item 5). Record the new records.json
sha256 in your completion report as information only - do not pin it anywhere.
acceptance_criteria: table:starting-wealth-by-class is absent from the generated SRD pack and cannot be re-emitted by the importer; no relabeled or renamed copy of the PHB table exists anywhere in the repo including tests and fixtures; SRD-only character creation completes with the starting-wealth path unavailable and reports a truthful reason; class starting-equipment choices and background currency grants still work under SRD-only; a synthetic add-on pack supplying a starting-wealth table re-enables the path, proving it was disabled by data rather than deleted; the stale loreweaver-0m9.5 manifest claim is corrected at the importer source; freeze-manifest.json is UNCHANGED and no thaw note was added; verify:dnd5e-srd-pack and verify:worktree pass; probe P12 exists as a permanent narrow guard that this record and its SRD provenance claim cannot silently return.
